Corn Delivery Requirements
To help keep deliveries safe, efficient, and compliant with our biosecurity standards, please review the requirements below before arriving at Buckeye Feed & Grain.
Delivery Specifications
Maximum moisture: 26%
Grain is priced at weigh-in
Please call the mill before arrival with any questions regarding your load.
Weaver Wash Required
All trucks must use the Weaver Wash before arriving at the mill — every time a delivery is made.
Weaver Wash Location
900 North Center Street
Versailles, Ohio 45380
Get Directions →
Biosecurity Requirements
To protect our mill and customers, we cannot accept corn from poultry operations.
This includes operations involving:
Chickens · Turkeys · Ducks · Guinea Fowl · Geese · Quail · Ostriches · Pigeons · Peacocks · Pheasants
Trucks delivering corn must not have been at a poultry operation within 72 hours of delivery to Buckeye Feed & Grain.
Have Questions?
If you are unsure whether your load meets these requirements, please call the mill before arriving. (937) 526-3914
